input.overview: Cabaret's center eject hole is the direct route: every hit scores 300 and advances Super Bonus toward its operator-set Special level. CHANGE switches rotate the Score Selector through colored values. When it reaches red, the rollovers and jet bumpers use their higher values and the left-center rollover lights for Extra Ball.
input.simpleOverview: In Cabaret, repeatedly shoot the center eject hole for 300 points and one Super Bonus advance. Use switches marked CHANGE to rotate the Score Selector. When red is selected, the rollovers and jet bumpers score their higher values and the left-center rollover lights for Extra Ball; collect it before another CHANGE switch moves the selector.
input.summary: Build Super Bonus through the center eject, then use the red Score Selector window for the lit left-center Extra Ball lane and improved switch values. Do not count on the disappearing center post: its position follows the match unit rather than a player-controlled qualification.

quickInfo.name: Center eject
quickInfo.summary: Scores 300 and advances Super Bonus one step on every entry.

quickInfo.name: Super Bonus
quickInfo.summary: Reaching the installed card's threshold awards Special, whose payoff is operator-selectable.

quickInfo.name: Score Selector
quickInfo.summary: Every CHANGE switch advances the colored selector and changes rollover and jet-bumper values.

quickInfo.name: Red selector
quickInfo.summary: Uses the higher values across the playfield and lights the left-center rollover for Extra Ball.

steps.text: Shoot the center eject hole whenever its return is manageable; each entry scores 300 and advances Super Bonus.
Use a CHANGE lane or switch to move the Score Selector toward red.
When red is selected, take the higher-value rollovers and jet bumpers without forcing a dangerous rebound.
Shoot the lit left-center rollover for Extra Ball before another CHANGE switch rotates the selector.
Return to the center eject until Super Bonus reaches the threshold printed on the installed score card.

buildsToward.title: A Super Bonus Special with a red-selector Extra Ball

steps.text: Advance Super Bonus at the center eject hole.
Rotate the Score Selector to red through CHANGE switches.
Collect the lit left-center Extra Ball lane, then continue the center-eject route.

techniques.name: Nudging
techniques.instruction: Use an early side nudge while the ball is above the lower slings; the physical-machine walkthrough shows that passive lower feeds drain quickly despite the center post.

cautions.issue: Super Bonus Special can award a replay, an extra ball, or 1,000 points, and the threshold differs by installed card.
cautions.response: Read the apron card and operator adjustment before choosing between the Super Bonus route and immediate high-value switches.

machineSetup: Confirm three- or five-ball play, the installed Super Bonus threshold, and whether Special awards a replay, an extra ball, or 1,000 points.

Test the center eject and Super Bonus step unit, every CHANGE switch, all four Score Selector colors, the left-center Extra Ball lane and lamp, jet-bumper value relays, center post, and tilt response.
